payload.name: Passport Photo 35x45mm by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 35 x 45 mm passport-style photo workflow.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based passport photo 35 x 45 mm workflow for forms that ask for a common ID-style photo shape before file-size checks. It routes visitors to local crop and resize steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
